title: Rank and Capacity via Specialization
prompt: Implement the `Rank` specializations (int -> 2, long -> 3), the `rank_v` variable template, and both `Capacity` partial specializations (`std::vector<T>` -> 0, `std::array<T, N>` -> N).

tests.name: rank_v reads through specializations
tests.hint: template <> struct Rank<int> { static constexpr int value = 2; }; (same for long), then template <class T> inline constexpr int rank_v = Rank<T>::value;

tests.name: Capacity peels N from std::array
tests.hint: template <class T, std::size_t N> struct Capacity<std::array<T, N>> { static constexpr std::size_t value = N; }; and a vector<T> one returning 0.
